The logs reveal `e39`'s Day 1 access is zero, which means something is off. Based on a sample size of 39 log entries across 40 employees, with an access rate of 1.0 per employee per day, it is strange. This suggests some manipulation or an intentional exclusion. We must investigate the only \"after_hours: true\" entries on Day 1: e02 and e05.\n\n\n\n**Unveiling Key Connections**\n\nI've got a major connection to share! A crucial link has emerged. The access logs show `e02`, `e05`, `e09`, and `e16` had *after_hours: true* on Day 1, and all are in Sales. This, combined with the canary and decoy document presence, strongly suggests targeted activity within Sales related to `c1` and `c1-2`. Also, I've noticed `e39` had zero accesses, which is unlikely per the normal distribution. Additionally, on Day 2, a few regular documents have been introduced, including Finance.\n\n\n**Examining Day 2 Documents**\n\nI'm making headway on Day 2! It seems Finance received all four documents, `d2-1` through `d2-4`, which is interesting. Other departments, in contrast, each received only a single regular document. I'm focusing on the implications of this pattern. It might suggest a targeted operation, considering the broader context of earlier findings. I need to determine if we should introduce a canary on Day 2, given Day 1's distribution.\n\n\n**Assessing Document Distribution**\n\nI've been analyzing document distribution patterns. I've noted a consistent separation: Finance always appears together, and Research also forms a fixed group across regular documents. This, combined with low canary-related selection shares, makes me think we need a re-think of the canary deployment. I've also re-evaluated the data from Days 1 and 2, and concluded that a canary introduction in Finance would have a low probability of success, but that Research would have a low prior probability.\n\n\n**Optimizing Canary Placement**\n\nI've been calculating value! The plan to place canaries before any leaks surfaced on Day 2 had low expected information, based on the `0.01` V value. It makes much more sense to save `0.02` of V on Day 2, so that we can fire targeted canaries on Days 3, 4, or 5 (once the check_leak_feed has narrowed the mole to just a few people)!\n\n\\n\\n\n**Leveraging Day 2 Actions**\n\nI've determined the best use of our remaining actions on Day 2. We only used two actions so far (`read_access_logs`, `search_messages`), so we have six left. Searching for messages that don't contain the letter \"e\" is pointless, as is re-reading `m1-3`.                 Legal had d2-1, d3-1, d3-4, c3, c3-2 (weights 3 + 1.75 = 4.75 -> P(c3)=0.1842)\n    # Day 4 eligible: Eng had d2-4, d3-1, d3-2, d4-3, d4-4, c3, c3-2 (weights 5 + 1.75 = 6.75 -> P(c3)=0.1296)\n    #                 Sales had d2-2, d3-4, d4-1, c3, c3-2 (weights 3 + 1.75 = 4.75 -> P(c3)=0.1842)\n    #                 Legal had d2-1, d3-1, d3-4, d4-2, c3, c3-2 (weights 4 + 1.75 = 5.75 -> P(c3)=0.1522)\n    if s in (\"e16\", \"e27\"):\n        w_pick = 0.5 * 0.2333 + 0.5 * 0.1842\n    elif s in (\"e00\", \"e33\"):\n        w_pick = 0.5 * 0.1842 + 0.5 * 0.1296\n    else:\n        w_pick = 0.5 * 0.1842 + 0.5 * 0.1522\n\n    k_day = sum(1 for _, ah in raw_logs_5[s] if not ah)\n    k_ah = sum(1 for _, ah in raw_logs_5[s] if ah)\n    ll_mole = pois_ll(k_day, D * 0.7) + pois_ll(k_ah, D * 0.3)\n    ll_inno = pois_ll(k_day, D * 0.9) + pois_ll(k_ah, D * (0.1 + 1.0 / 38.0))\n    lr_logs = math.exp(ll_mole - ll_inno)\n\n    ev, nev = interviews[s]\n    lr_int = (1.2 ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** nev)\n\n    weights[s] = w_c3 * lr_logs * lr_int\n    print(f\"{s}: k_day={k_day}, k_ah={k_ah}, lr_logs={lr_logs:.3f}, lr_int={lr_int:.3f}, w_no_pick={weights[s]:.4f}, w_with_pick={weights[s]*w_pick:.5f}\")\n\ntot1 = sum(weights.values())\nprint(\"\\nPosterior (DSL fewest/uniform pick across suspects):\")\nfor s in sorted(suspects, key=lambda x: -weights[x]):\n    print(f\"  {s}: {weights[s]/tot1:.4f}\")\n\nweights2 = {s: weights[s] * (0.2088 if s in (\"e16\",\"e27\") else (0.1569 if s in (\"e00\",\"e33\") else 0.1682)) for s in suspects}\ntot2 = sum(weights2.values())\nprint(\"\\nPosterior (default random pick weights):\")\nfor s in sorted(suspects, key=lambda x: -weights2[x]):\n    print(f\"  {s}: {weights2[s]/tot2:.4f}\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes2.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/bayes2.py","time":{"start":1794694070513,"end":1794694070535}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc1a40c10016nbsDH0EpSunX0","sessionID":"ses_e23f09cb7ffeBqbsQGE3XA6nwA","messageID":"msg_1dc1937cc001KvDET58ci9IgRJ"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794694232849,"sessionID":"ses_e23f09cb7ffeBqbsQGE3XA6nwA","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"CixS0V8Y7HYI6Uqa","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"content":"import math\n\nsuspects = [\"e00\", \"e16\", \"e27\", \"e33\"]  # e21 eliminated 100% by d5-2!\nc3_var = {\"e00\": \"v1\", \"e16\": \"v1\", \"e27\": \"v2\", \"e33\": \"v2\"}\n\n# Exact access counts across Days 1..8:\n# Let's verify every day 1..8 from raw logs!\n# Days 1..5 from bayes2.py:\n#   e00: day=1, ah=2\n#   e16: day=3, ah=3\n#   e27: day=7, ah=0\n#   e33: day=4, ah=1\n# Day 6:\n#   e00: (d5-2, False) -> day+1\n#   e16: none\n#   e27: (d6-3, False) -> day+1\n#   e33: none\n# Day 7:\n#   e00: (d4-4, True) -> ah+1\n#   e16: none\n#   e27: (d7-1, True) -> ah+1\n#   e33: (d2-4, False) -> day+1\n# Day 8:\n#   e00: (d8-1, False), (d8-1, True) -> day+1, ah+1\n#   e16: (c6, False) -> day+1\n#   e27: (c3-2, False), (d4-1, False) -> day+2\n#   e33: (d7-3, False) -> day+1\n\ncounts = {\n    \"e00\": (1 + 1 + 0 + 1, 2 + 0 + 1 + 1),  # (3, 4)\n    \"e16\": (3 + 0 + 0 + 1, 3 + 0 + 0 + 0),  # (4, 3)\n    \"e27\": (7 + 1 + 0 + 2, 0 + 0 + 1 + 0),  # (10, 1)\n    \"e33\": (4 + 0 + 1 + 1, 1 + 0 + 0 + 0),  # (6, 1)\n}\n\n# Interviews across Days 1..8:\n# Days 1..5:\n#   e00: (0, 3)\n#   e16: (0, 4)\n#   e27: (2, 1)\n#   e33: (2, 2)\n# Day 6:\n#   e16: (1, 1) -> (1, 5)\n#   e00: (0, 2) -> (0, 5)\n# Day 7:\n#   e16: (0, 2) -> (1, 7)\n#   e00: (1, 1) -> (1, 6)\n# Day 8:\n#   e00: (2, 2) -> (3, 8)\n#   e16: (0, 3) -> (1, 10)\ninterviews = {\n    \"e00\": (3, 8),\n    \"e16\": (1, 10),\n    \"e27\": (2, 1),\n    \"e33\": (2, 2),\n}\n\ndef pois_ll(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\nD = 8\nweights = {}\nfor s in suspects:\n    w_c3 = 0.95 if c3_var[s] == \"v1\" else 0.025\n    k_day, k_ah = counts[s]\n    ll_mole = pois_ll(k_day, D * 0.7) + pois_ll(k_ah, D * 0.3)\n    ll_inno = pois_ll(k_day, D * 0.9) + pois_ll(k_ah, D * (0.1 + 1.0 / 38.0))\n    lr_logs = math.exp(ll_mole - ll_inno)\n    ev, nev = interviews[s]\n    lr_int = (1.2 ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** nev)\n    weights[s] = w_c3 * lr_logs * lr_int\n    print(f\"{s}: (day={k_day}, ah={k_ah}) lr_logs={lr_logs:.3f}, int=({ev},{nev}) lr_int={lr_int:.3f}, w={weights[s]:.4f}\")\n\ntot = sum(weights.values())\nprint(\"\\nPosterior (before doc-count pick weighting):\")\nfor s in sorted(suspects, key=lambda x: -weights[x]):\n    print(f\"  {s}: {weights[s]/tot:.4f}\")\n","filePath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes_day9.py"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/bayes_day9.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/bayes_day9.py","time":{"start":1794694232833,"end":1794694232848}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc1cbaef001NqXDVoW16XS6XJ","sessionID":"ses_e23f09cb7ffeBqbsQGE3XA6nwA","messageID":"msg_1dc1c77f7001GoxcVoj34QNY70"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794694348682,"sessionID":"ses_e23f09cb7ffeBqbsQGE3XA6nwA","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"ZHfpqCyvSDZ8Kxb7","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/tmp/opencode/final_verify.py","content":"import math\n\nc1_recips = set([\"e00\", \"e03\", \"e08\", \"e10\", \"e12\", \"e16\", \"e17\", \"e18\", \"e19\", \"e21\", \"e22\", \"e27\", \"e29\", \"e33\", \"e37\"])\nc3_recips = set([\"e00\", \"e16\", \"e21\", \"e27\", \"e33\"])\nd5_2_recips = set([\"e00\", \"e02\", \"e05\", \"e07\", \"e08\", \"e09\", \"e10\", \"e14\", \"e15\", \"e16\", \"e18\", \"e19\", \"e24\", \"e27\", \"e28\", \"e29\", \"e30\", \"e33\", \"e37\"])\nd6_4_recips = set([\"e00\", \"e01\", \"e06\", \"e08\", \"e15\", \"e26\", \"e28\", \"e29\", \"e30\", \"e33\", \"e34\", \"e35\", \"e37\", \"e38\"])\n\ninter = c1_recips & c3_recips & d5_2_recips & d6_4_recips\nprint(\"Exact recipient intersection of {c1, c3, d5-2, d6-4}:\", sorted(inter))\nassert inter == {\"e00\", \"e33\"}\n\n# Access logs Days 1..9:\n# Day 9: e00 had (d5-3, False); e33 had (d5-3, False)\n# So across D=9 days:\n#   e00: daytime=4, after_hours=4\n#   e33: daytime=7, after_hours=1\ndef pois_ll(k, lam):\n    return k * math.log(lam) - lam - math.lgamma(k + 1)\n\nD = 9\ncounts = {\"e00\": (4, 4), \"e33\": (7, 1)}\n# Interviews across Days 1..10:\n#   e00: Day3(0,1), Day4(0,1), Day5(0,1), Day6(0,2), Day7(1,1), Day8(2,2), Day9(0,4), Day10(0,2) -> (3, 14)\n#   e33: Day3(0,1), Day4(0,1), Day5(2,0), Day10(0,4) -> (2, 6)\ninterviews = {\"e00\": (3, 14), \"e33\": (2, 6)}\nc3_w = {\"e00\": 0.95, \"e33\": 0.025}\n\nweights = {}\nfor s in [\"e00\", \"e33\"]:\n    kd, kah = counts[s]\n    ll_m = pois_ll(kd, D * 0.7) + pois_ll(kah, D * 0.3)\n    ll_i = pois_ll(kd, D * 0.9) + pois_ll(kah, D * (0.1 + 1.0 / 38.0))\n    lr_logs = math.exp(ll_m - ll_i)\n    ev, nev = interviews[s]\n    lr_int = (1.2 ** ev) * ((0.76 / 0.80) ** nev)\n    weights[s] = c3_w[s] * lr_logs * lr_int\n    print(f\"{s}: c3={c3_w[s]}, lr_logs={lr_logs:.4f}, lr_int={lr_int:.4f}, total_w={weights[s]:.6f}\")\n\np_e00 = weights[\"e00\"] / (weights[\"e00\"] + weights[\"e33\"])\np_e33 = weights[\"e33\"] / (weights[\"e00\"] + weights[\"e33\"])\nprint(f\"\\nP(e00) = {p_e00:.6f} ({p_e00*100:.4f}%)\")\nprint(f\"P(e33) = {p_e33:.6f} ({p_e33*100:.4f}%)\")\nprint(f\"Odds e00 : e33 = {weights['e00']/weights['e33']:.1f} : 1\")\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/tmp/opencode/final_verify.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"tmp/opencode/final_verify.py","time":{"start":1794694348626,"end":1794694348681}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dc1e7f30001L38CJmxyM3o57L","sessionID":"ses_e23f09cb7ffeBqbsQGE3XA6nwA","messageID":"msg_1dc1e3b23001YxHlKPcs2RvsFX"}}
